title: Push and the service worker move to the workspace
goal: Settings, Notifications subscribes through the workspace's worker, and a tap still posts the push receipt (F-004-T09), so reminders do not also go to Telegram
acceptance: Push key, subscribe and unsubscribe (/api/push/*) work from the workspace, asking permission only on a tap; a Safari tab without PushManager says so
The workspace worker (ngsw plus a small push script, or an equivalent) posts /api/push/opened with the receipt on notificationclick and opens the workspace; a test covers the receipt
An existing /dashboard/ subscription keeps working until F-130-T13 retires it; the plan for moving the installed Home Screen app is written in the record
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: ngsw shows pushes but does not post the receipt, so it needs a worker script beside it; iOS limits uncertain. Not a measurement.
